comparison.objective: Route a wire around formboard pins along a printed path, then insert its plug.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable routing around obstacles followed by connector alignment and insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Wire passes every pin on the indicated side, plug is inserted, and released; tolerances and damage criteria are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests deformable cable routing and insertion, a meaningfully different ability from rigid impact fracture and free-fragment recovery.
